english_retrieval.title: Amit Shah | Official Website | Shri Amit Shah
english_retrieval.snippet: * Landmark Achievements in Six Years as Union Home Minister. ## “Home Minister Shri Amit Shah Speaking on the Ideology of the BJP”. ## “Home Minister Shri Amit Shah Speaking on Prime Minister Narendra Modi”. On account of his unwavering commitment to the party and an unceasing spirit to work for it, Amit Shah’s career graph soared through the ranks like Secretary of the Ahmedabad City BJP, National Treasurer of the Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha, and Gujarat state secretary of the BJP. In 2017, he was elected as a member of the Rajya Sabha from Gujarat and in 2019 to the Lok Sabha from the Gandhinagar constituency of his home state. Paving his way to national politics a year before the 2014 Lok Sabha Polls, Amit Shah was chosen as the National General Secretary of the party and was made in-charge of Uttar Pradesh. In recognition of his contribution to the party’s victory in the 2014 Lok Sabha polls, he was made the Party’s National President in the same year.

english_retrieval.title: ‘He likes scaring people’: how Modi’s right-hand man, Amit Shah, runs India | India | The Guardian
english_retrieval.snippet: India’s minister of home affairs, Amit Shah (left), and the prime minister, Narendra Modi (right). # ‘He likes scaring people’: how Modi’s right-hand man, Amit Shah, runs India. For 40 years, Amit Shah has been at Narendra Modi’s side – his confidant, consigliere and enforcer. Today he is India’s second-most powerful man, and he is reshaping the country in radical ways. They escorted off a man named Sohrabuddin Sheikh, who was joined on the side of the road by his wife, Kausar. On the other end of the line, each time, was a senior Gujarati politician who ran the state’s home ministry, which put him in charge of the police. It alleged that the officers who killed Sheikh and his wife were working on Shah’s orders. He told the press that he was the victim of a political witch-hunt, orchestrated by the central government, which was then run by the Indian National Congress party, the main opposition to Shah’s own party, the BJP.
